title: Glycoconjugate strategy for GLUT-driven curcumin delivery and anticancer activity in breast cancer cells.
authors: Hassan, Safaa S; Rashidi, Fatma B; Seddik, Ramy G; El-Sayed, Areej W; Mohamed, Habiba A; Mohamed, Hager W; Kenawy, Menna M; Hussein, Nouran B; Afify, Nourhan A; Megahed, Noura M; Zeinhom, Reem M; Abdultawab, Ziad A; Elgohary, Ayatallah; Hamido, Nashwa; Elwakil, Ahmed I; Alzoghaly, Hadeel A; Nabil, Martina O; Ahmed, Ehab A; Ismail, Khaled M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究糖缀合物钒配合物作为GLUT靶向抗癌药，虽含DNA结合实验和分子对接，但核心是抗癌活性与代谢通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法上仅简单对接，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Selective targeting of cancer cells is a critical strategy in anticancer therapy, and the overexpression of glucose transporters (GLUTs) in malignant cells provides an attractive avenue for achieving this selectivity. In this study, we report the synthesis and biological evaluation of glycoconjugate vanadyl complexes as GLUT-directed anticancer agents against breast cancer. A Schiff base ligand (CG) was synthesized through the condensation of curcumin (C) and glucosamine (G), followed by complexation with vanadyl to form [VO(CG)(2)].5H(2)O. The synthesized compounds were comprehensively characterized by elemental analysis, MS, NMR, FT-IR, TGA, molar conductance, and magnetic susceptibility measurements. Spectroscopic and computational studies confirmed that the ligand coordinates in a bidentate chelating mode via the azomethine nitrogen and the enolic oxygen. Biological evaluation in MCF-7 breast cancer cells included cytotoxicity assays, molecular docking, DNA-binding studies, and quantitative gene expression analysis. Both compounds exhibited cytotoxic activity, with the CG ligand showing the highest potency (IC(5)(0) = 7.51 +/- 0.12 mug/mL or 14.2 muM). Notably, co-treatment with the GLUT inhibitor quercetin significantly increased the IC(5)(0) value, suggesting the involvement of GLUT-mediated cellular uptake. Molecular docking studies indicated favorable binding affinity toward GLUT, while DNA-binding experiments demonstrated interaction with DNA. Treatment of MCF-7 cells with the glycoconjugate ligand induced DNA damage, modulated the expression of cell cycle- and apoptosis-related genes, and promoted apoptosis. Flow cytometric analysis demonstrated that the glycoconjugate significantly arrested MCF-7 cells in the S-phase (49.40% vs 22.22% in control). This finding is consistent with impaired cell cycle progression and may be associated with the observed DNA interaction. Quantitative real-time PCR analysis of the CG compound revealed significant upregulation of BAX and CDKN1A (p21) (p </= 0.05) and pronounced upregulation of STK11 (LKB1) (p </= 0.001), suggesting activation of the AMPK signaling pathway and a metabolic stress response. Overall, the glycoconjugate ligand induces apoptosis and cell cycle arrest through oxidative and metabolic stress mediated by AMPK-STK11 signaling, highlighting its potential as a GLUT-targeted chemotherapeutic agent for breast cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 选择性靶向癌细胞是抗癌治疗中的关键策略，而恶性细胞中葡萄糖转运蛋白（GLUTs）的过表达为实现这种选择性提供了有吸引力的途径。在本研究中，我们报道了糖缀合物氧钒配合物作为靶向GLUT的抗乳腺癌药物的合成及生物学评价。通过姜黄素（curcumin, C）与氨基葡萄糖（glucosamine, G）的缩合反应合成了席夫碱配体（CG），随后与氧钒离子配合形成[VO(CG)(2)].5H(2)O。所合成化合物通过元素分析、质谱、核磁共振、傅里叶变换红外光谱、热重分析、摩尔电导率和磁化率测量进行了全面表征。光谱和计算研究证实，配体通过偶氮甲碱氮和烯醇氧以双齿螯合模式配位。在MCF-7乳腺癌细胞中的生物学评价包括细胞毒性实验、分子对接、DNA结合研究和定量基因表达分析。两种化合物均表现出细胞毒性活性，其中CG配体显示出最高效力（IC(5)(0) = 7.51 +/- 0.12 mug/mL 或 14.2 muM）。值得注意的是，与GLUT抑制剂槲皮素联合处理显著增加了IC(5)(0)值，提示GLUT介导的细胞摄取参与其中。分子对接研究表明其与GLUT具有良好结合亲和力，而DNA结合实验证明其与DNA存在相互作用。用糖缀合物配体处理MCF-7细胞诱导了DNA损伤，调节了细胞周期和凋亡相关基因的表达，并促进了细胞凋亡。流式细胞术分析表明，该糖缀合物显著将MCF-7细胞阻滞在S期（49.40% 对比对照组的22.22%）。这一发现与细胞周期进程受损一致，并可能与观察到的DNA相互作用相关。对CG化合物的定量实时PCR分析显示，BAX和CDKN1A（p21）显著上调（p </= 0.05），STK11（LKB1）显著上调（p </= 0.001），提示AMPK信号通路激活和代谢应激反应。总体而言，糖缀合物配体通过AMPK-STK11信号介导的氧化和代谢应激诱导细胞凋亡和细胞周期阻滞，突显其作为靶向GLUT的乳腺癌化疗药物的潜力。
